title: Yooka-Laylee upgrade skips Xbox: 'isn't viable' 🦎
subject: yookalaylee
description:
Should Playtonic bring it to Xbox later? 👇

Playtonic says Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition will launch December 15, 2026 on PS5, Switch 2 and PC, but not Xbox Series X|S, because the cost of more platforms "just isn't viable for us at this time." The 2019 original remains playable on Xbox.

Sources: Pure Xbox (Nov 27, 2026), Playtonic on X (Nov 27, 2026), Steam news (Playtonic)
Game footage © Playtonic Games.

scenes.text: Yooka-Laylee's Definitive Edition is skipping Xbox.
The upgraded Impossible Lair arrives December 15 on PS5, Switch 2 and Steam.
Xbox owners asked why. On November 27, the studio answered on X.
"The cost of bringing it to more platforms just isn't viable for us at this time," Playtonic wrote.
It added that it can't commit to other platforms for the foreseeable future.
The 2019 original stays on Xbox, and Digital Foundry's John Linneman says it already runs at native 4K on Series X.
